name: swagger
description: HTTP Telegram workspace with a coloured control panel and UTC quotas.

FORCE_SUB_CHAT_ID.description: Exact required channel ID (-100...) or public @username. Bot must be channel admin.

BOT_TOKEN.description: Telegram bot token from BotFather. Keep secret.

OWNER_ID.description: Positive numeric Telegram owner user ID.

API_MODE.description: sandbox: built-in fictional HTTP service (no URL/key); http: configured provider; mock: offline fixture.

API_BASE_URL.description: Trusted HTTPS adapter base URL. Required in http mode.

DB_PATH.description: SQLite file. Heroku filesystem is ephemeral: demo only.

BOT_MODE.description: polling for worker; webhook for an HTTPS web process.

WEBHOOK_URL.description: Public HTTPS origin without /telegram; webhook mode only.

PORT.description: HTTP health listener port; hosting platforms may override.
